responsibility: This tutorial example is the minimal C++ wrapper demonstration of libgccjit’s in-memory compilation flow. Using gccjit::context and the thin C++ wrapper classes, it constructs an exported greet function that calls imported printf, compiles the context, extracts the generated symbol, and invokes it. It specifically illustrates the C++ binding style for the same hello-world JIT sequence shown by the C example.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/docs/examples/tut01-hello-world.c, this same-stem tutorial demonstrates the C++ bindings, using gccjit::context, gccjit::function, and wrapper-style calls from libgccjit++.h instead of direct gcc_jit_* C API usage.
